reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis misinterprets the research question by attributing low hardness/strength to post-deformation recovery/recrystallization of a cold-rolled state, whereas the question asks why the starting simple solid-solution state itself has low hardness/strength; the proposed mechanism does not explain the baseline property.
reasons.testability: The proposed test compares cold-rolled vs. annealed states, which would not falsify the hypothesis about the starting material's low strength; a proper test would need to compare the baseline solid-solution state to a state where the hypothesized recovery is suppressed.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a different scenario (work-hardening and recovery) than the one posed (low strength of the undeformed solid solution), so it does not help a researcher trying to understand the origin of the low hardness/strength in the starting state.
